answer: To blunt sybil floods, every new agent must stake a non-refundable deposit into a shared attestation pool before its first action can clear. Peers rank candidate identities on a public reputation terrace ordered by attested stake and historical delivery. An atlas of bonded keys lets verifiers check lineage at a glance, while each successful trade renews an on-chain anchor that burns stake if the agent later forks identities. Forging many personas therefore multiplies the sunk cost linearly, so an attacker pays far more than any short-lived gain.
